slug: 长生从假死开始万年之后我还在
content_zh:
断龙崖坠命
晨雾锁死断龙崖。
谷底翻卷的冷风卷着山石的寒凉，死死压在崖顶。
玄霄宗全员弟子肃立崖边，紫袍加身的掌门玄霄子立在高台，掌心覆着镇岳剑剑柄，威压沉沉覆落。
全场死寂，落针可闻。
陈默站在最前排，距万丈崖口，不过三步。
一身洗得发白的粗布麻衣早已磨损严重，袖口毛边翻飞。满头白发散乱肩头，被山风吹得贴在瘦削的脖颈上。他不过二十岁模样，清瘦脱相，颧骨突兀，干裂的唇瓣毫无血色。唯独右眼生得异于常人，一枚琥珀色瞳孔透亮清冷，在朦胧晨光里，透着生人勿近的疏离。
他是玄霄宗三年前捡来的弃徒。
三年前雨夜惊雷，宗门后山禁地崩塌，玄霄子从乱石堆里扒出了奄奄一息的他。彼时稚童满身泥泞，不哭不闹，只抬着一双异瞳望天，死气沉沉。
玄霄子断言他命格残缺，本是早夭绝命之相，不该存于世间，却因一丝莫名契机，破例将他收为外门弟子，养在山门。
这三年，是无尽的磋磨与冷眼。
陈默经脉天生破败，灵气入体便散，修行如同竹篮打水，万年不得寸进。
“废物”之名，冠了他整整三年。
全宗弟子无人愿与他为伍，避之如避邪祟。唯有内门的柳如烟，偶尔会悄悄塞给他几枚劣质边角丹药，聊作慰藉。
今日，宗门十年一度的资质清查大典。
往年不过驱逐几名平庸杂役，无人在意。可今日，第一个被点名处置的，便是他陈默。
死寂的高台上，玄霄子终于开口。
声音不高，却穿透呼啸山风，砸在每个人耳中。
“陈默。”
二字落地，全场气氛骤然冻结。

陈默缓缓抬头，目光平静，无悲无喜。
“你命格残缺，逆天苟活。昨夜雷云覆宗，紫电三劈护山大阵，皆因你命理冲撞而起。”玄霄子语气淡漠，不带半分波澜，“你是宗门隐患，留之必引天罚。今日，逐你出宗，坠崖消灾。”
话音落，周遭弟子隐隐骚动，无人求情，无人辩驳，只剩赤裸裸的漠然。
一道温和的身影缓步走出。
李慕白，宗门天资最盛的大师兄，一身雪白锦袍衬得温润如玉，眉眼带笑，步步走到陈默身侧。
“师弟，认命吧。师尊也是为了宗门安宁，于你，亦是解脱。”
柔声劝慰的刹那，李慕白眼底笑意骤敛，脚尖无声探出，精准勾住陈默的右腿脚踝。
与此同时，身后四名早已待命的弟子齐声暴喝：“清除孽障！”
四人合力，重重撞向陈默后背！
陈默瞳孔骤缩。
他三日之前便被封印周身灵力，经脉空空如也，一身修为尽数禁锢。猝不及防之下，根本无从借力抵挡。
巨力贯体，身形瞬间失控前倾！
content_en:
Falling to Death on Broken Dragon Cliff
The morning fog blocks Broken Dragon Cliff.
The cold wind blowing at the bottom of the valley carries the coldness of the rocks and presses them firmly on the top of the cliff.
All the disciples of the Xuanxiao Sect stood at the edge of the cliff. The purple-robed leader Xuanxiaozi stood on the high platform, his palm covering the hilt of the Zhenyue Sword, and the pressure fell heavily.
The whole place was dead silent and you could hear a pin drop.
Chen Mo stood in the front row, only three steps away from the entrance of the cliff.
The coarse linen clothes that had been washed white had already been severely worn, and the raw edges of the cuffs were flying. A head full of white hair scattered around his shoulders, blown by the mountain wind and stuck to his thin neck. He looked no more than twenty years old, with a thin face and protruding cheekbones, and chapped lips that were colorless. Only his right eye was unusually born, with an amber pupil that was bright and cold. In the hazy morning light, it showed a distance that kept strangers away from him.
He is an abandoned disciple picked up by Xuanxiao Sect three years ago.
Three years ago, there was a thunderstorm on a rainy night, and the forbidden area behind the sect collapsed. Xuan Xiaozi pulled out the dying man from the pile of rocks. At that time, the child was covered in mud, neither crying nor fussing. He only looked up at the sky with a pair of strange eyes, lifeless.
Xuan Xiaozi asserted that his fate was incomplete and that he was destined to die young and should not exist in the world. However, due to an inexplicable opportunity, he made an exception and accepted him as an outer disciple and raised him at the mountain gate.
These three years have been endless discussions and cold looks.
Chen Mo's meridians are naturally broken, and the spiritual energy dissipates as soon as it enters the body. His practice is like fetching water from a bamboo basket, and he cannot make any progress for ten thousand years.
He was called "trash" for three whole years.
None of the disciples in the sect wanted to be with him, and they avoided him like he was avoiding evil spirits. Only Liu Ruyan from the inner sect would occasionally secretly give him a few low-quality corner pills to comfort him.
Today is the sect’s once-in-a-decade qualification inspection ceremony.
In previous years, they only expelled a few mediocre handymen, but no one cared. But today, the first person to be named and punished was Chen Mo.
On the high platform in dead silence, Xuan Xiaozi finally spoke.
The sound was not high, but it penetrated the roaring mountain wind and hit everyone's ears.
"Chen Mo."
As soon as the two words fell to the ground, the atmosphere in the whole place suddenly froze.
Chen Mo slowly raised his head, his eyes calm, neither sad nor happy.
"Your destiny is incomplete and you are living against the will of the sky. Last night, thunder clouds fell over the sect, and the purple lightning struck the mountain guarding formation three times, all due to the collision of your numerology."
After the words fell, the disciples around him were in a faint commotion. No one begged for mercy or argued, only naked indifference remained.
A gentle figure walked out slowly.
Li Mubai, the most talented elder brother in the sect, was dressed in a snow-white brocade robe that was as gentle as jade. He walked up to Chen Mo step by step with a smile on his face.
"Junior brother, accept your fate. Master is also doing this for the sake of the peace of the sect, and it is also a relief for you."
The moment he comforted her softly, the smile in Li Mubai's eyes suddenly disappeared, and his toes silently reached out, accurately hooking Chen Mo's right ankle.
At the same time, the four disciples behind him who had been on standby shouted in unison: "Clear the evil obstacles!"
The four of them worked together and slammed into Chen Mo's back!
Chen Mo's pupils shrank suddenly.
Three days ago, his spiritual energy was sealed, his meridians were empty, and his entire body was imprisoned. Caught off guard, there is no way to resist.
A huge force penetrated the body, and the body instantly fell forward out of control!
